                                    var $tabela = $('#tb-materias');

                                    var $materias = $comp.find('[materias]').first();

                                    var $wrapper = $tabela.closest('.dataTables_wrapper');

                                    if (!$materias.length || !$mapa.length || !$wrapper.length || !$scrollBody.length) return;

                                    var topoTabela = $wrapper.offset().top;
                                    var baseMapa = $mapa.offset().top + $mapa.outerHeight();
                                    var alturaRodape = 0;
                                    var alturaCabecalhoTabela = $wrapper.find('.dataTables_scrollHead').outerHeight(true) || 0;

                                    $wrapper.children(':visible').not('.dataTables_scroll').each(function () {
                                        alturaRodape += $(this).outerHeight(true);
                                    });

                                    var alturaScroll = Math.floor(baseMapa - topoTabela - alturaRodape - alturaCabecalhoTabela - 12);
                                    alturaScroll = Math.max(160, alturaScroll);

                                    });

            var data = new Date();

            var nome = nomeCookie + '=';

                }

                        if (boxes.length > maxSemCarrossel) {
                            const splideWrapper = document.createElement('section');
                            splideWrapper.id = 'slider-mesa-diretora';
                            splideWrapper.className = 'splide';
                            splideWrapper.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Carrossel da Mesa Diretora');
                            const splideTrack = document.createElement('div');
                            splideTrack.className = 'splide__track';
                            const splideList = document.createElement('ul');
                            splideList.className = 'splide__list';
                            boxes.forEach(function(box) {
                                const slide = document.createElement('li');
                                slide.className = 'splide__slide';
                                slide.appendChild(box);
                                splideList.appendChild(slide);
                            });
                            splideTrack.appendChild(splideList);
                            splideWrapper.appendChild(splideTrack);
                            componentes.innerHTML = '';
                            componentes.appendChild(splideWrapper);

                                    },
                                }
                            }).mount();
                        }
                    }
                });

                        if (boxes.length > maxSemCarrossel) {
                            const splideWrapper = document.createElement('section');
                            splideWrapper.id = 'slider-mesa-diretora';
                            splideWrapper.className = 'splide';
                            splideWrapper.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Carrossel da Mesa Diretora');
                            const splideTrack = document.createElement('div');
                            splideTrack.className = 'splide__track';
                            const splideList = document.createElement('ul');
                            splideList.className = 'splide__list';
                            boxes.forEach(function(box) {
                                const slide = document.createElement('li');
                                slide.className = 'splide__slide';
                                slide.appendChild(box);
                                splideList.appendChild(slide);
                            });
                            splideTrack.appendChild(splideList);
                            splideWrapper.appendChild(splideTrack);
                            componentes.innerHTML = '';
                            componentes.appendChild(splideWrapper);

                                    },

                            }).mount();
                        }
                    }
